| `OgeBadgeValue` | `number \| string \| null \| undefined` | What a badge shows. |
| `OgeBadgeSeverity` | `'danger' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'neutral'` | Colour vocabulary. |
| `OgeBadgePosition` | `'top-end' \| 'top-start' \| 'bottom-end' \| 'bottom-start'` | Logical corner vocabulary. |
| `OgeBadgeOverlap` | `'rectangle' \| 'circle'` | Shape of the wrapped content. |
| `OgeBadgeSize` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | Size vocabulary. |
| `OgeBadgeProps` | `interface` | Props of `<OgeBadge>`. |

### Configuration

#### Properties

_OgeAvatarConfigProvider_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messages` | `OgeAvatarMessages` | Every user-facing string: `avatar` (fallback name, "Avatar"), `withStatus` ("{name} ({status})"), the presence labels `online` / `away` / `busy` / `offline`, and `overflow` — the ICU plural naming the surplus avatar ("{count, plural, one {# more} other {# more}}"). |
| `size / shape` | `—` | Defaults for the matching inputs of the avatar and the group. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | Default locale of the initials casing and the "+N" digits (`<OgeLocaleProvider>` sets it from the pack). |

_OgeBadgeConfigProvider_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messages` | `OgeBadgeMessages` | Every user-facing string: `count` (ICU plural, "5 new items"), `overflow` ("{max}+"), `overflowCount` ("More than 99 new items") and `dot` ("New"). |
| `max / severity / position` | `—` | Defaults for the matching inputs. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | Default locale of the digits and the plural description. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeAvatarConfig / OgeAvatarConfigInput` | `interface` | Resolved config and its partial input (`messages` merged one level deep). |
| `OgeAvatarMessages` | `interface` | The avatar catalog (`layout.avatar` in the locale packs). |
| `OgeBadgeConfig / OgeBadgeConfigInput` | `interface` | Resolved config and its partial input. |
| `OgeBadgeMessages` | `interface` | The badge catalog (`layout.badge` in the locale packs). |
| `useOgeAvatarConfig / useOgeBadgeConfig` | `hook` | Read the resolved config of the nearest provider. |
| `OGE_DEFAULT_AVATAR_CONFIG / OGE_DEFAULT_AVATAR_MESSAGES / OGE_DEFAULT_BADGE_CONFIG / OGE_DEFAULT_BADGE_MESSAGES` | `const` | The English defaults (from `@oge-ui/behavior`). |

### <OgeChip>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `''` | Visible text and accessible name. |
| `icon` | `string` | `—` | SVG path data (`d`, 24×24 viewBox) of a leading `aria-hidden` icon. |
| `avatar` | `OgeChipAvatar` | `—` | A small leading avatar — the image, else the initials, else a person glyph. Always `aria-hidden`. Wins over `icon`. |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the chip as a toggle `<button aria-pressed>` with a check glyph for the pressed state. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `—` | Pressed state (controlled); `defaultSelected` is the uncontrolled initial value. |
| `defaultSelected` | `boolean` | `false` | Initial pressed state when uncontrolled. |
| `removable` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds a separate, real remove button named by the `remove` message (&ldquo;Remove {label}&rdquo;); Delete / Backspace on a selectable chip&rsquo;s toggle remove too. 24px target, 44px on coarse pointers. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the toggle and the remove button. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `config ?? 'md'` | Density preset — 24 / 28 / 34 px tall. |
| `stylingMode` | `'filled' \| 'outlined'` | `config ?? 'filled'` | `filled` is the tinted surface, `outlined` a hairline frame on a transparent background. |
| `severity` | `'neutral' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | `—` | Colour; `undefined` is the neutral chip. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `—` | Accessible name of the toggle when the label is not enough; also names the remove button. |
| `className` | `string` | `—` | Extra classes on the host element. |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | `—` | Inline styles on the host element. |

#### Methods

_Ref handle (OgeChipHandle)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus()` | `() => void` | Focuses the toggle button, else the remove button. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onSelectedChange` | `(selected: boolean) => void` | The pressed state a toggle committed. |
| `onRemoved` | `(event: OgeChipRemovedEvent) => void` | The remove button (or Delete / Backspace) was pressed — hide the chip. |

| --- | --- | --- |

| `OgeChipStylingMode` | `'filled' \| 'outlined'` | Surface presets. |

### <OgeChipList>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly OgeChipItem[]` | `[]` | The chips, in order. `key` identifies a chip in every event; the list moves no data. |
| `selectionMode` | `'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'` | `'none'` | Selection turns the list into a WAI-ARIA APG **listbox**; with `none`, removable chips form an APG layout **grid** and static chips a plain **list** (`ogeChipListRole`). A second press clears a `single` selection. |
| `selectedKeys` | `readonly OgeChipKey[]` | `—` | Keys of the selected chips (controlled); `defaultSelectedKeys` is the uncontrolled initial value. |
| `defaultSelectedKeys` | `readonly OgeChipKey[]` | `[]` | Initial selection when uncontrolled. |
| `removable` | `boolean` | `false` | Default removability of every chip (`OgeChipItem.removable` overrides it). In a listbox the ✕ is `aria-hidden` and Delete / Backspace is the keyboard path; in a grid it is a real button. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables every chip (`aria-disabled`): nothing toggles, nothing is removed. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `config ?? 'md'` | Density preset — 24 / 28 / 34 px tall. |
| `stylingMode` | `'filled' \| 'outlined'` | `config ?? 'filled'` | `filled` is the tinted surface, `outlined` a hairline frame on a transparent background. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `—` | Accessible name; a listbox or grid falls back to the `chipList` message. |
| `renderChip` | `(context: OgeChipRenderContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces every chip&rsquo;s label — the Angular `[ogeChipTemplate]`. Keep it non-interactive. |
| `className` | `string` | `—` | Extra classes on the host element. |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | `—` | Inline styles on the host element. |

#### Methods

_Ref handle (OgeChipListHandle)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus(index?)` | `(index?: number) => void` | Focuses the chip at `index` (default: the roving tab stop). |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onSelectedKeysChange` | `(keys: OgeChipKey[]) => void` | The committed selection. |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `(event: OgeChipSelectionChangedEvent) => void` | A click, Space or Enter changed the selection: next and previous keys, the toggled item and index. |
| `onItemClick` | `(event: OgeChipItemClickEvent) => void` | A chip was clicked or activated with Enter / Space. |
| `onItemRemoving` | `(event: OgeChipItemRemovingEvent) => void` | Cancelable: a chip is about to be removed. Set `cancel` to keep it. |
| `onItemRemoved` | `(event: OgeChipItemRemovedEvent) => void` | Drop the chip from `items` now; focus moves to its neighbour (Delete: next, Backspace: previous). |

| `OgeChipItem` | `{ key; label; icon?; avatar?; disabled?; removable?; severity? }` | One chip. |
| `OgeChipKey` | `string \| number` | Identity of a chip. |
| `OgeChipSelectionMode` | `'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'` | Selection vocabulary. |
| `OgeChipSelectionChangedEvent` | `{ selectedKeys; previousKeys; item; index; event? }` | Payload of `onSelectionChanged`. |
| `OgeChipItemClickEvent` | `{ item; index; event }` | Payload of `onItemClick`. |
| `OgeChipItemRemovingEvent` | `{ item; index; event?; cancel: boolean }` | Payload of `onItemRemoving`. |
| `OgeChipItemRemovedEvent` | `{ item; index; event? }` | Payload of `onItemRemoved`. |

### <OgeAlert>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `severity` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'error'` | `config ?? 'info'` | Meaning of the message — colour, glyph, hidden prefix and (with `live: auto`) the role: `error` / `warning` are `role="alert"`, `info` / `success` `role="status"`. |
| `title` | `string` | `—` | Bold first line above the message; the severity prefix moves into it. |
| `stylingMode` | `'soft' \| 'outlined' \| 'filled'` | `config ?? 'soft'` | `soft` is a tinted surface with a severity rail, `outlined` a coloured frame, `filled` the solid severity colour. |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders a real dismiss button that runs the cancelable close; focus moves to the next tabbable element when the alert held it. |
| `live` | `'auto' \| 'polite' \| 'assertive' \| 'off'` | `'auto'` | `auto` derives the role from the severity, `assertive` / `polite` force one, `off` renders none. The role stays while hidden, so showing again is announced. |
| `showIcon` | `boolean` | `true` | Shows the severity glyph (or `icon`); `false` drops the icon column. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the default glyph inside an `aria-hidden` wrapper — the Angular `[ogeAlertIcon]`. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | `—` | A row of real controls under the message — the Angular `[ogeAlertActions]`. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `—` | Accessible name of the live region — only written while it has a role. |
| `visible` | `boolean` | `—` | Whether the alert is shown (controlled); `false` renders nothing and sets `hidden`. |
| `defaultVisible` | `boolean` | `true` | Initial visibility when uncontrolled. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | `—` | The message. |
| `className` | `string` | `—` | Extra classes on the host element. |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | `—` | Inline styles on the host element. |

#### Methods

_Ref handle (OgeAlertHandle)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `show()` | `() => void` | Shows the alert again. |
| `close()` | `() => void` | Runs the cancelable close, as the dismiss button does. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onVisibleChange` | `(visible: boolean) => void` | The visibility a close / show committed. |
| `onClosing` | `(event: OgeAlertClosingEvent) => void` | Cancelable: the alert is about to close. Set `cancel` to keep it. |
| `onClosed` | `(event: OgeAlertClosedEvent) => void` | The alert closed. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeAlertProps` | `interface` | Props of `<OgeAlert>`. |
| `OgeAlertHandle` | `{ show(): void; close(): void }` | The ref handle. |
| `OgeAlertSeverity` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'error'` | Severity vocabulary. |
| `OgeAlertStylingMode` | `'soft' \| 'outlined' \| 'filled'` | Surface presets. |
| `OgeAlertLive` | `'auto' \| 'polite' \| 'assertive' \| 'off'` | Live-region behaviour. |
| `OgeAlertClosingEvent` | `{ event?: Event; cancel: boolean }` | Payload of `onClosing`. |

### <OgeTimeline>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly OgeTimelineItem[]` | `[]` | The entries, in display order — the list's order is its meaning. Fields: `key?`, `title?`, `description?`, `time?: Date \| string`, `opposite?`, `severity?`, `variant?`, `icon?` (SVG path data). |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `config ?? 'vertical'` | Axis of the timeline. Horizontal entries share a row and the list scrolls inline when they do not fit. |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'alternate' \| 'alternate-reverse'` | `config ?? 'end'` | Side of the axis the content sits on — logical, so RTL mirrors. `alternate` starts at the end side and swaps per entry, `alternate-reverse` starts at the start side; both render the opposite column (the entry&rsquo;s `opposite`, else its time). |
| `dateFormat` | `Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions \| undefined` | `config ?? { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }` | Format of `Date` times (through the core Intl cache). String times are shown verbatim. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `config ?? runtime locale` | BCP 47 locale of `Date` times. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Accessible name of the `<ol>` ("Order history"). Recommended when a page has more than one list. |
| `renderContent` | `(context: OgeTimelineItemRenderContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the built-in time / title / description block of every entry — the counterpart of `[ogeTimelineContentTemplate]`. Interactive content stays in the Tab order. |
| `renderMarker` | `(context: OgeTimelineItemRenderContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the dot on the axis. The marker column is `aria-hidden`, so say the same thing in the content. |
| `renderOpposite` | `(context: OgeTimelineItemRenderContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the opposite-side text of an alternating timeline. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Applied to the `.oge-timeline` root. |

#### Types

_Render props_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeTimelineItemRenderContext` | `{ item: OgeTimelineItem; index: number; side: 'start' \| 'end'; first: boolean; last: boolean }` | Argument of all three render props. |
| `OgeTimelineProps` | `interface` | Props of `<OgeTimeline>`. |

_Vocabulary_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeTimelineItem` | `interface` | One entry: `key?`, `title?`, `description?`, `time?: Date \| string`, `opposite?`, `severity?`, `variant?`, `icon?` (SVG path data). A `Date` time is written into `<time dateTime>` from its local fields (never `toISOString`). |
| `OgeTimelineOrientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | Axis union. |
| `OgeTimelineAlign` | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'alternate' \| 'alternate-reverse'` | Content side union. |
| `OgeTimelineSeverity` | `'accent' \| 'neutral' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | Marker colour union (default `accent`). |
| `OgeTimelineMarkerVariant` | `'filled' \| 'outlined'` | Solid marker, or a ring for pending / future entries. |

### Configuration

#### Properties

There is deliberately no `messages` block: the timeline renders no user-facing strings of its own. |

### <OgeAppBar>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `'top' \| 'bottom'` | `config ?? 'top'` | Edge the bar belongs to — decides the hairline and shadow side, the sticky / fixed edge and which safe-area inset pads it. |
| `positionMode` | `'static' \| 'sticky' \| 'fixed'` | `config ?? 'static'` | `sticky` sticks to its edge of the nearest scroll container, `fixed` pins to the viewport (full width, inline safe-area insets). Both use the `--oge-z-app-bar` layer and pad with `env(safe-area-inset-*)` as a floor. |
| `color` | `'default' \| 'primary' \| 'inverse' \| 'transparent'` | `config ?? 'default'` | Surface: the page surface with a hairline, the accent, the dark tooltip surface, or none. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `config ?? 'md'` | Density preset — 48 / 56 / 64 px rows. |
| `elevated` | `boolean` | `false` | Draws a shadow on the bar&rsquo;s content edge. |
| `landmark` | `'none' \| 'banner' \| 'contentinfo' \| 'navigation' \| 'region'` | `'none'` | Landmark role, only on request: `banner` for the one page header, `contentinfo` for a page footer, `navigation` / `region` (with `ariaLabel`) for a named secondary bar. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Accessible name of the landmark — written only when `landmark` is not `none` (a role-less element may not carry one). |
| `centerAlign` | `'start' \| 'center'` | `'start'` | Alignment of the center section&rsquo;s content. |
| `start` | `ReactNode` | `—` | Start section content — the counterpart of `[ogeAppBarStart]`. |
| `center` | `ReactNode` | `—` | Center section content rendered before `children` — the counterpart of `[ogeAppBarCenter]`. |
| `end` | `ReactNode` | `—` | End section content — the counterpart of `[ogeAppBarEnd]`. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | `—` | Center section content (the title) — like unmarked projected content in Angular. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Applied to the `.oge-app-bar` root. |

### <OgeListView>

#### Properties

_Data_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly T[]` | `[]` | The items, in order. The component is generic: `T` is inferred from the prop in JSX, so render props and callbacks are typed. |
| `keyExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown)` | `'id'` | Field (or function) giving each item&rsquo;s key — the identity in `selectedKeys` and every event. Primitive items are their own key. |
| `displayExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `—` | Field (or function) giving the text of the default row, the search and type-ahead. |
| `disabledExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `—` | Field (or function) marking an item disabled: it stays visible with `aria-disabled`, the keyboard skips it and it never selects. |
| `groupExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) \| undefined` | `—` | Field (or function) grouping the items (first-appearance order) under sticky headers. Each group is a labelled segment: `role="group"` with `aria-label` in a listbox, a `listitem` holding a labelled nested `list` otherwise; the visible header is `aria-hidden`. |

_Selection_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectionMode` | `'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'` | `config ?? 'none'` | `none` renders a `role="list"` with a roving tab stop; `single` / `multiple` an APG listbox whose viewport tracks the active option with `aria-activedescendant` (`aria-multiselectable` for multiple). |
| `selectedKeys` | `readonly OgeListViewKey[]` | `[]` | Keys of the selected items — controlled (pair with `onSelectedKeysChange`; `defaultSelectedKeys` for uncontrolled). Space toggles, Enter selects (single), Shift+arrows / Shift+Space / Shift+click extend a range, Ctrl+Shift+Home/End select to an edge, Ctrl+A selects all (or none). |
| `showSelectionControls` | `boolean \| undefined` | `config ?? false` | Draws an `aria-hidden` check (multiple) or radio (single) glyph in every row; the state itself is `aria-selected`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the whole list: nothing selects or activates, the search field is disabled, the viewport leaves the Tab order. |

_Scrolling & paging_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `height` | `number \| string \| undefined` | `—` | Height of the scroll viewport — a number is px, a string any CSS length. A virtualized list without one uses 320px. |
| `virtualScroll` | `boolean \| OgeListViewVirtualScrollOptions` | `false` | Windowed rendering with fixed row heights (`{ itemHeight: 44, groupHeaderHeight: 32, overscan: 6 }`) on core&rsquo;s offset tree. Keyboard navigation scrolls the active option into the window first; the header of a group the window starts inside stays pinned. |
| `pageLoadMode` | `'none' \| 'button' \| 'scroll'` | `config ?? 'none'` | `button` renders a Load more button under the list, `scroll` calls `onLoadMoreRequested` when the viewport nears the end (once per page — also when a first page does not fill the viewport). The arrival of the next items is announced politely. |
| `hasMore` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether more items can be requested; nothing is requested without it. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the loading row under the list, sets `aria-busy` and holds further requests. |

_Search, actions & labels_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `searchEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders a labelled search field (with a clear button) above the list; ArrowDown moves into the list, Escape clears. Matching is locale- and accent-insensitive and the result count is announced. |
| `searchExpr` | `OgeListViewSearchExpr<T> \| undefined` | `—` | Field(s) the search matches — one expression or an array; default the display text. |
| `searchMode` | `'contains' \| 'startsWith'` | `config ?? 'contains'` | How the search text matches. |
| `searchValue` | `string` | `''` | The search text — controlled (pair with `onSearchValueChange`; `defaultSearchValue` for uncontrolled). |
| `itemActions` | `readonly OgeListViewItemAction[]` | `[]` | Per-item actions, revealed by a horizontal swipe on touch (mirrored in RTL) and on hover / focus with a mouse. They are `aria-hidden` glyphs inside the row (an option cannot hold buttons); the keyboard twin is each action&rsquo;s `shortcut`, listed in `aria-keyshortcuts` and in a shared description. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | `messages.listLabel` | Accessible name of the list / listbox. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `config ?? runtime default` | BCP 47 locale of the announced counts (ICU plurals). |

_Render props_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `renderItem` | `(context: OgeListViewItemRenderContext<T>) => ReactNode` | Replaces each row&rsquo;s content — the Angular `[ogeListViewItemTemplate]`. Context: `item`, `index`, `key`, `selected`, `active`, `disabled`, `group`. Keep it non-interactive. |
| `renderGroup` | `(context: { group: string; count: number }) => ReactNode` | Replaces each sticky header&rsquo;s text — the Angular `[ogeListViewGroupTemplate]`. |
| `renderEmpty` | `(context: { searching: boolean; searchValue: string }) => ReactNode` | Replaces the empty state — the Angular `[ogeListViewEmptyTemplate]`. |
| `renderFooter` | `(context: { loadMore; loading; hasMore; itemCount }) => ReactNode` | Content under the list; replaces the Load more button — the Angular `[ogeListViewFooterTemplate]`. |
| `className` | `string` | Extra classes on the host element. |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | Inline styles on the host element. |

#### Methods

_Ref handle (OgeListViewHandle)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus()` | `() => void` | Moves focus into the list — the listbox viewport, or the active item of a plain list — and scrolls the active item into view. |
| `scrollToItem(key)` | `(key: OgeListViewKey) => void` | Scrolls the item with `key` into view and makes it the active one. |
| `clearSelection()` | `() => void` | Clears the selection. |
| `selectAll()` | `() => void` | Selects every enabled item of a multiple-selection list and announces the count. |
| `clearSearch()` | `() => void` | Empties the search field. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onSelectedKeysChange` | `(keys: OgeListViewKey[]) => void` | The committed selection — the controlled half of `selectedKeys`. |
| `onSearchValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | The typed search text — the controlled half of `searchValue`. |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `(event: OgeListViewSelectionChangedEvent<T>) => void` | The selection changed through a click, a key, a range, Ctrl+A or a handle method — with the previous, added and removed keys, the item and the originating event. |
| `onItemClick` | `(event: OgeListViewItemClickEvent<T>) => void` | An item was clicked or activated with Enter. |
| `onItemActionClick` | `(event: OgeListViewItemActionClickEvent<T>) => void` | An item action ran — by tap, click or its keyboard shortcut (one callback for all three). |
| `onLoadMoreRequested` | `(event: OgeListViewLoadMoreEvent) => void` | The list asks for more items: `reason` `button` or `scroll`, and the `itemCount` held now. |
| `onActiveItemChanged` | `(event: OgeListViewActiveItemChangedEvent<T>) => void` | The active (keyboard) item moved. |

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeListViewProps` | `interface` | Props of `<OgeListView>`. |
| `OgeListViewHandle` | `{ focus; scrollToItem; clearSelection; selectAll; clearSearch }` | The ref handle. |
| `OgeListViewItemRenderContext / OgeListViewGroupRenderContext / OgeListViewEmptyRenderContext / OgeListViewFooterRenderContext` | `interface` | Contexts of the four render props. |

_Vocabulary_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeListViewKey` | `string \| number` | Identity of an item. |
| `OgeListViewExpr / OgeListViewSearchExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => unknown) / one or an array` | Field names or reader functions. |
| `OgeListViewSelectionMode` | `'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'` | Selection union. |
| `OgeListViewPageLoadMode / OgeListViewSearchMode` | `'none' \| 'button' \| 'scroll' / 'contains' \| 'startsWith'` | Paging and search unions. |
| `OgeListViewItemAction` | `{ key; label; icon?; severity?: 'neutral' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'; shortcut? }` | A swipe / hover action; `icon` is SVG path data, `shortcut` an `aria-keyshortcuts` value (`Delete`, `Shift+A`). |
| `OgeListViewVirtualScrollOptions` | `{ itemHeight?; groupHeaderHeight?; overscan? }` | Options form of `virtualScroll`. |

Translated in every `@oge-ui/locales` pack (`layout.listView`, wired by `<OgeLocaleProvider>`). |

| `OgeListViewConfig / OgeListViewConfigInput` | `interface` | The config shape and its partial input; `OGE_DEFAULT_LIST_VIEW_CONFIG` is the resolved default. |

### <OgeDataView>

#### Properties

_Data_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly T[]` | `[]` | The items in their own order. With `remoteOperations`: the current page. |
| `keyExpr` | `OgeDataViewKeyExpr<T>` | `'id'` | Field (dot paths allowed) or function giving each item’s key — the identity in `selectedKeys` and every callback. |
| `displayExpr` | `OgeDataViewDisplayExpr<T>` | `—` | The text an item shows without `renderItem`; falls back to its `title`, `name`, `text` or `label` field. |
| `remoteOperations` | `boolean` | `false` | The app sorts, searches and pages: answer `onOptionsChanged` with the page as `items` and the total as `itemCount`. |
| `itemCount` | `number` | `—` | Total item count under `remoteOperations`; defaults to the processed items’ length. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the items `aria-busy`; with nothing to show yet it draws skeleton tiles and a visually hidden “Loading…”. |
| `locale` | `string` | `config ?? runtime locale` | BCP 47 locale of the sort comparison (numeric collation, so “Item 9” sorts before “Item 10”). |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `—` | Accessible name of the items; a listbox falls back to the `dataView` message. |
| `toolbar` | `ReactNode` | `—` | Your own controls in the header, before the built-in tools — the Angular `[ogeDataViewToolbar]` slot. |
| `renderItem` | `(context: OgeDataViewRenderContext<T>) => ReactNode` | `—` | Renders each item in both layouts — the Angular `[ogeDataViewItemTemplate]`. Non-interactive in a selectable view. |
| `renderListItem` | `(context: OgeDataViewRenderContext<T>) => ReactNode` | `—` | Renders each item in the `list` layout; falls back to `renderItem`. |
| `renderEmpty` | `(context: OgeDataViewEmptyContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the empty state; `filtered` says whether a search or filter caused it. |
| `className` | `string` | `—` | Extra classes on the host element. |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | `—` | Inline styles on the host element. |

_Layout_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | `'grid' \| 'list'` | `config ?? 'grid'` | Responsive columns or one item per row (controlled; `defaultLayout` uncontrolled). |
| `showLayoutSwitch` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the grid / list toggle-button group (`aria-pressed`) in the header. |
| `minItemWidth` | `number` | `config ?? 240` | Narrowest grid cell in px before another column fits. Resolved by a container query on the view’s own inline size, never the window. |
| `columns` | `number` | `—` | A fixed column count for the grid layout; collapses to one column in a container under 480px. |
| `gap` | `number \| string` | `16px` | Gap between items — px number or any CSS length. |

_Paging_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pageSize` | `number` | `config ?? 0` | Items per page; `0` shows every item. |
| `pageIndex` | `number` | `0` | 0-based current page (controlled; `defaultPageIndex` uncontrolled), clamped into the page range when rendered. |
| `showPager` | `boolean` | `true` | Renders the built-in pager when there is more than one page. Set it to `false` and drive an `<OgePagination>` with `pageIndex` for the full bar. |
| `showPageInfo` | `boolean` | `true` | Renders the `{from}–{to} of {itemCount}` text beside the pager. |

_Sorting, search & filtering_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sortOptions` | `readonly OgeDataViewSortOption[]` | `[]` | Choices of the built-in sort select (plus a direction toggle); empty hides both. |
| `sort` | `OgeDataViewSort \| null` | `null` | The active sort (controlled; `defaultSort` uncontrolled). Text compares with the locale’s collator, numbers / dates / booleans numerically, empty values last. |
| `filter` | `((item: T) => boolean) \| null` | `—` | A predicate the items must pass (client-side only). |
| `searchEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the search field in the header. |
| `searchValue` | `string` | `''` | The search text (controlled; `defaultSearchValue` uncontrolled). Every word must occur, compared case-, accent- and locale-insensitively. |
| `searchExpr` | `OgeDataViewSearchExpr<T>` | `—` | Field(s) or function the search matches; default every primitive field. |

_Selection_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectionMode` | `'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'` | `'none'` | Selection turns the list into an APG listbox: one roving tab stop, arrows in reading order (mirrored in RTL), Up / Down by the measured column count, PageUp / PageDown turn the page, Space / Enter toggle, Ctrl+A selects all. Options are leaves, so `renderItem` must not render controls. |
| `selectedKeys` | `readonly OgeDataViewKey[]` | `[]` | Keys of the selected items (controlled; `defaultSelectedKeys` uncontrolled). |

#### Methods

_Ref handle (OgeDataViewHandle)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus(index?)` | `(index?: number) => void` | Focuses the item at `index` of the page (default: the tab stop); without selection the first focusable control inside the items. |
| `goToPage(index)` | `(index: number) => void` | Shows page `index` (clamped) and calls `onPageChanged` when it changed. |
| `setLayout(layout)` | `(layout: OgeDataViewLayout) => void` | Switches the layout and calls `onLayoutChanged` when it changed. |
| `clearSelection()` | `() => void` | Deselects everything. |
| `selectAll()` | `() => void` | Selects every item that passes the filter and search — multiple selection only. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onLayoutChange` | `(layout: OgeDataViewLayout) => void` | The controlled half of `layout`. |
| `onPageIndexChange` | `(pageIndex: number) => void` | The controlled half of `pageIndex`. |
| `onSortChange` | `(sort: OgeDataViewSort \| null) => void` | The controlled half of `sort`. |
| `onSearchValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | The controlled half of `searchValue`. |
| `onSelectedKeysChange` | `(keys: OgeDataViewKey[]) => void` | The controlled half of `selectedKeys`. |
| `onLayoutChanged` | `(event: OgeDataViewLayoutChangedEvent) => void` | The layout changed through the switch or `setLayout()`. |
| `onPageChanged` | `(event: OgeDataViewPageChangedEvent) => void` | The page changed through the pager, PageUp / PageDown or `goToPage()`; the new page is announced politely. |
| `onSortChanged` | `(event: OgeDataViewSortChangedEvent) => void` | The sort changed through the built-in select or direction toggle (the page resets to 0). |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `(event: OgeDataViewSelectionChangedEvent<T>) => void` | The selection changed through a click, Space / Enter, Ctrl+A or a handle method. |
| `onItemClick` | `(event: OgeDataViewItemClickEvent<T>) => void` | An item was clicked (or activated with Enter / Space in a listbox). |
| `onOptionsChanged` | `(event: OgeDataViewOptionsChangedEvent) => void` | Sort, search or page changed — the request to answer under `remoteOperations`. |

#### Types

_Component types_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeDataViewProps` | `interface` | Props of `<OgeDataView>` (generic over the item type). |
| `OgeDataViewHandle` | `{ focus; goToPage; setLayout; clearSelection; selectAll }` | The ref handle. |
| `OgeDataViewRenderContext` | `{ item: T; index: number; layout: OgeDataViewLayout; selected: boolean }` | Context of `renderItem` / `renderListItem`. |
| `OgeDataViewEmptyContext` | `{ filtered: boolean; text: string }` | Context of `renderEmpty`. |

_Vocabulary_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeDataViewLayout` | `'grid' \| 'list'` | Responsive columns, or one item per row. |
| `OgeDataViewSelectionMode` | `'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'` | `none` renders a `list`; `single` / `multiple` an APG `listbox`. |
| `OgeDataViewKey` | `string \| number` | An item identity, from `keyExpr`. |
| `OgeDataViewKeyExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => OgeDataViewKey)` | Field (dot paths allowed) or function; an item without a usable key falls back to its index. |
| `OgeDataViewDisplayExpr` | `string \| ((item: T) => string)` | Where the fallback text of a template-less item comes from. |
| `OgeDataViewSearchExpr` | `string \| readonly string[] \| ((item: T) => string)` | The text the search matches. |
| `OgeDataViewSort` | `{ field: string; direction: 'asc' \| 'desc' }` | The active sort. |
| `OgeDataViewSortDirection` | `'asc' \| 'desc'` | Direction of a sort. |
| `OgeDataViewSortOption` | `{ field: string; label: string }` | One choice of the built-in sort select. |
| `OgeDataViewLayoutChangedEvent` | `{ layout; previousLayout; event? }` | Payload of the layout change. |
| `OgeDataViewPageChangedEvent` | `{ pageIndex; previousPageIndex; pageSize; event? }` | Payload of the page change (0-based pages). |
| `OgeDataViewSortChangedEvent` | `{ sort: OgeDataViewSort \| null; previousSort; event? }` | Payload of the sort change. |
| `OgeDataViewSelectionChangedEvent` | `{ selectedKeys; previousKeys; item?; event? }` | Payload of the selection change; `item` is absent for Ctrl+A and the methods. |
| `OgeDataViewItemClickEvent` | `{ item: T; index; key; event }` | Payload of an item click / activation. |
| `OgeDataViewOptionsChangedEvent` | `{ sort; searchValue; pageIndex; pageSize }` | The request a `remoteOperations` app answers with the next page. |

### <OgeTileLayout>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly OgeTileLayoutItemData[]` | `[]` | The tiles. Fields: `key`, `title?`, `colSpan?`, `rowSpan?`, `order?`, `minColSpan?` / `maxColSpan?`, `minRowSpan?` / `maxRowSpan?`, `resizable?`, `reorderable?`. |
| `columns` | `number` | `config ?? 4` | Number of grid columns. Column spans are clamped to it; below 480px of container width the layout collapses to one column. |
| `rowHeight` | `number \| 'auto'` | `config ?? 160` | Height of one row track in px, or `auto` to size rows by their content. |
| `gap` | `number` | `config ?? 16` | Gap between tiles in px. |
| `columnWidth` | `number \| string` | `—` | Fixed column width (`240` px or any CSS length); default equal `1fr` columns. |
| `resizable` | `boolean \| 'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `false` | Default resizability of every tile (the item&rsquo;s own `resizable` overrides it): a corner handle for the pointer, Ctrl+Shift+arrows for the keyboard. |
| `reorderable` | `boolean` | `true` | Default reorderability: drag by the header, Ctrl+arrows on the keyboard. |
| `state` | `OgeTileLayoutState` | `—` | The committed layout (controlled; pair with `onStateChange`). Passing the prop — even as `undefined`, which lays the tiles out from their own `order` and spans — makes the component controlled; leave it out for an uncontrolled layout. |
| `defaultState` | `OgeTileLayoutState` | `—` | Initial layout when uncontrolled. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `messages.layoutLabel ('Dashboard')` | Accessible name of the list. |
| `locale` | `string` | `config ?? runtime default` | BCP 47 locale of the announcements&rsquo; plural rules. |
| `renderHeader` | `(context: OgeTileLayoutRenderContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the header title of every tile — the Angular `[ogeTileLayoutHeaderTemplate]`. Buttons inside it never start a drag. |
| `renderContent` | `(context: OgeTileLayoutRenderContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | The body of every tile — the Angular `[ogeTileLayoutContentTemplate]`. |
| `className` | `string` | `—` | Extra classes on the host element. |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | `—` | Inline style of the host element. |

#### Methods

_ref handle (OgeTileLayoutHandle)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus(key?)` | `(key?: OgeTileLayoutKey) => void` | Focuses a tile (default: the current tab stop). |
| `moveTile(key, toIndex)` | `(key: OgeTileLayoutKey, toIndex: number) => boolean` | Moves a tile through the cancelable pipeline (`source: 'api'`); `false` when nothing moved. |
| `resizeTile(key, colSpan, rowSpan)` | `(key: OgeTileLayoutKey, colSpan: number, rowSpan: number) => boolean` | Gives a tile new spans, clamped to its bounds, through the cancelable pipeline. |
| `getState()` | `() => OgeTileLayoutState` | The current layout as a serializable state. |
| `applyState(state)` | `(state: unknown) => boolean` | Validates (`sanitizeOgeTileLayoutState`) and applies a persisted state; `false` and no change when it is invalid. Calls `onLayoutChanged`. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onReordering` | `(event: OgeTileLayoutReorderingEvent) => void` | A tile is about to move — set `cancel` to keep it. |
| `onReordered` | `(event: OgeTileLayoutReorderedEvent) => void` | A tile moved. |
| `onResizing` | `(event: OgeTileLayoutResizingEvent) => void` | A tile is about to change its spans — set `cancel` to keep them. |
| `onResized` | `(event: OgeTileLayoutResizedEvent) => void` | A tile changed its spans. |
| `onLayoutChanged` | `(event: OgeTileLayoutChangedEvent) => void` | The layout changed (move, resize, `applyState`) — persist `state`. |
| `onStateChange` | `(state: OgeTileLayoutState) => void` | Every committed layout — the controlled half of `state`. |

#### Types

_Render props_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeTileLayoutRenderContext` | `{ item: OgeTileLayoutItemData; key; index; colSpan; rowSpan }` | Argument of `renderHeader` / `renderContent`; the spans are the live preview while a resize is in progress. |

_Events & state_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeTileLayoutReorderingEvent` | `{ item; key; fromIndex; toIndex; source: 'pointer' \| 'keyboard' \| 'api'; event?; cancel }` | A tile is about to move — set `cancel` to keep it where it is. The pointer drop and the keyboard emit the same payload. |
| `OgeTileLayoutReorderedEvent` | `Omit<OgeTileLayoutReorderingEvent, 'cancel'>` | A tile moved. |
| `OgeTileLayoutResizingEvent` | `{ item; key; previous: OgeTileLayoutSpan; next: OgeTileLayoutSpan; source; event?; cancel }` | A tile is about to change its spans (already clamped to its bounds) — set `cancel` to keep them. |
| `OgeTileLayoutResizedEvent` | `Omit<OgeTileLayoutResizingEvent, 'cancel'>` | A tile changed its spans. |
| `OgeTileLayoutChangedEvent` | `{ state: OgeTileLayoutState; source }` | The layout changed through a move, a resize or `applyState()` — the state to persist. |
| `OgeTileLayoutState` | `{ version: 1; tiles: { key; order; colSpan; rowSpan }[] }` | The serializable layout. `order` is the 0-based display position. Tiles the state does not list are placed after the known ones; entries whose key no longer exists are ignored. |
| `sanitizeOgeTileLayoutState(input, knownKeys?)` | `(input: unknown, knownKeys?: Iterable<OgeTileLayoutKey>) => OgeTileLayoutState \| null` | Validates persisted / imported state (untrusted input): never throws, rejects prototype keys at any depth, drops unknown fields, duplicate and unknown keys, keeps integer spans ≥ 1 and renumbers the order. `applyState()` runs it for you. |

_Vocabulary_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeTileLayoutItemData` | `interface` | One tile as data: `key`, `title?`, `colSpan?`, `rowSpan?`, `order?`, `minColSpan?` / `maxColSpan?`, `minRowSpan?` / `maxRowSpan?`, `resizable?`, `reorderable?`. |
| `OgeTileLayoutResizable` | `boolean \| 'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | Which spans the user may change. |
| `OgeTileLayoutSpan` | `{ colSpan: number; rowSpan: number }` | Column and row span of a tile. |
| `OgeTileLayoutKey` | `string \| number` | Identity of a tile. |
| `OgeTileLayoutChangeSource` | `'pointer' \| 'keyboard' \| 'api'` | What started a change; `api` is a method call. |

_Keyboard_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Arrow keys / Home / End` | `focus` | Move focus between tiles (one roving tab stop; ↑/↓ go to the closest tile in the row above / below). Content inside a tile keeps its own Tab order, and the tile keys only act while the tile itself is focused. |
| `Ctrl+← / Ctrl+→` | `move` | Move the focused tile one position earlier / later (mirrored in RTL). ⌘ works as Ctrl. |
| `Ctrl+↑ / Ctrl+↓` | `move` | Move the focused tile to the position of the tile above / below. |
| `Ctrl+Shift+← / Ctrl+Shift+→` | `resize` | Shrink / grow the column span (mirrored in RTL), within the tile&rsquo;s bounds. |
| `Ctrl+Shift+↑ / Ctrl+Shift+↓` | `resize` | Shrink / grow the row span. |
| `Escape` | `cancel` | Cancels a pointer drag or resize in progress. |

### Configuration

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeTileLayoutConfigProvider` | `({ config?: OgeTileLayoutConfigInput; children }) => JSX.Element` | Subtree-scoped defaults for `columns`, `rowHeight`, `gap`, `locale` and the `messages` — the React counterpart of `provideOgeTileLayoutConfig()`. |
| `useOgeTileLayoutConfig()` | `() => OgeTileLayoutConfig` | Reads the resolved config of the nearest provider. |

#### Types

_Messages_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeTileLayoutMessages` | `interface` | `layoutLabel`, `tileRoleDescription`, `untitledTile` (`{position}`), `keyboardHint`, `dragHint`, `moved` (`{title}`, `{position}`, `{count}`), `resized` (ICU plurals over `{colSpan}` / `{rowSpan}`), `unchanged`, `dragCancelled`. Translated in every `@oge-ui/locales` pack (`layout.tileLayout`). |
| `OgeTileLayoutConfig / OgeTileLayoutConfigInput` | `interface` | The config shape (`messages`, `columns?`, `rowHeight?`, `gap?`, `locale?`) and its partial input; `OGE_DEFAULT_TILE_LAYOUT_CONFIG` / `OGE_DEFAULT_TILE_LAYOUT_MESSAGES` are the resolved defaults. |

### <OgeCarousel>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly OgeCarouselItem[]` | `[]` | Data-driven slides, rendered after the declarative `<OgeCarouselSlide>` children. Fields: `key?`, `image?` (through `sanitizeResourceUrl`), `imageAlt?` (default `''` = decorative), `title?`, `description?`, `thumbnail?`, `label?`. The default render draws the image and a frosted caption. |
| `selectedIndex` | `number` | `0` | Index of the first visible slide (controlled; `defaultSelectedIndex` when uncontrolled), clamped to the slides. |
| `slidesPerView` | `number` | `1` | Slides shown side by side. Above one the picker switches from the APG tab list to a row of buttons. |
| `gap` | `number \| string` | `0 (one per view) / 16 (several)` | Space between slides — px number or any CSS length. |
| `height` | `number \| string` | `—` | Height of the slide viewport (px number or CSS length). Without it the track takes the tallest slide. |
| `indicators` | `'dots' \| 'thumbnails' \| 'none'` | `config ?? 'dots'` | The picker under the slides. Thumbnails are decorative images (the tab keeps its "Slide N" name). |
| `showNavigation` | `boolean` | `config ?? true` | The previous / next buttons; `aria-disabled` at an end without `loop`. |
| `loop` | `boolean` | `config ?? false` | Wraps the buttons, the picker keys and swipes. The carousel rewinds rather than cloning slides. |
| `autoplay` | `boolean` | `false` | Rotates the slides and renders the rotation control first (WCAG 2.2.2). Pauses while hovered or hidden; keyboard focus entering stops it until the user restarts it. Starts stopped under `prefers-reduced-motion`. |
| `autoplayInterval` | `number` | `config ?? 5000` | Rotation interval in ms (at least 1000). |
| `pauseOnHover` | `boolean` | `true` | Pauses the rotation while a mouse or pen pointer is over it. |
| `swipeEnabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Lets touch, pen and mouse drags move between slides on the shared pointer gesture. |
| `locale` | `string` | `config ?? runtime default` | BCP 47 locale the slide numbers are formatted in. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | `—` | Accessible name. Set, the host is a named `region`; unset, a `group` named by the `label` message. |
| `renderSlide` | `(context: OgeCarouselSlideRenderContext) => ReactNode` | `—` | Replaces the image + caption of every `items` slide (the Angular `[ogeCarouselSlideTemplate]`). |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | `—` | Declarative `<OgeCarouselSlide>` elements (the Angular `<oge-carousel-slide>`). |
| `className` | `string` | `—` | Extra classes on the host element. |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | `—` | Inline styles on the host element. |

#### Methods

_Ref handle (OgeCarouselHandle)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `next()` | `() => void` | Shows the next slide (wraps only with `loop`). |
| `previous()` | `() => void` | Shows the previous slide (wraps only with `loop`). |
| `goTo(index)` | `(index: number) => void` | Shows slide `index` (clamped). |
| `play()` | `() => void` | Starts the rotation (only while `autoplay` is on). |
| `pause()` | `() => void` | Stops the rotation until the user or `play()` restarts it. |
| `focus()` | `() => void` | Focuses the selected picker entry, else the first control. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onSelectedIndexChange` | `(index: number) => void` | The index a move committed. |
| `onSlideChanged` | `(event: OgeCarouselSlideChangedEvent) => void` | The first visible slide changed: `index`, `previousIndex`, `source`. |
| `onAutoplayChanged` | `(event: OgeCarouselAutoplayChangedEvent) => void` | The rotation was started or stopped by the user or the API (`playing`, `source: 'user' \| 'api'`). |

#### Types

_Declarative slides & render props_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeCarouselSlide` | `component` | One declarative slide; its children are the body. Props: `label`, `thumbnail`, `visible`. Renders nothing by itself — the carousel reads its props. |
| `OgeCarouselSlideRenderContext` | `{ item: OgeCarouselItem; index: number; count: number; active: boolean }` | Context of `renderSlide`. |
| `OgeCarouselProps / OgeCarouselSlideProps` | `interface` | Props of the two components. |
| `OgeCarouselHandle` | `{ next; previous; goTo; play; pause; focus }` | The ref handle. |

_Vocabulary_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeCarouselItem` | `interface` | One data-driven slide: `key?`, `image?` (through `sanitizeResourceUrl`), `imageAlt?` (default `''` = decorative), `title?`, `description?`, `thumbnail?`, `label?`. |
| `OgeCarouselIndicators` | `'dots' \| 'thumbnails' \| 'none'` | Picker union. |
| `OgeCarouselPickerMode` | `'tabs' \| 'buttons'` | The APG picker shape. |
| `OgeCarouselChangeSource` | `'next' \| 'previous' \| 'picker' \| 'swipe' \| 'autoplay' \| 'api'` | What moved the carousel. |
| `OgeCarouselSlideChangedEvent` | `{ index: number; previousIndex: number; source: OgeCarouselChangeSource }` | Payload of `onSlideChanged`. |
| `OgeCarouselAutoplayChangedEvent` | `{ playing: boolean; source: 'user' \| 'api' }` | Payload of `onAutoplayChanged`. |

### Configuration

#### Properties

_OgeCarouselConfigProvider_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messages` | `OgeCarouselMessages` | Every user-facing string: the role descriptions `carousel` / `slide`, the fallback `label`, `previous`, `next`, `play`, `pause`, `picker`, `slideLabel`, `slideTitleLabel` and `goToSlide`. Translated in every `@oge-ui/locales` pack (`layout.carousel`). |
| `indicators / loop / autoplayInterval / showNavigation / locale` | `—` | Defaults for the matching props. `useOgeCarouselConfig()` reads the resolved value. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeCarouselConfigProvider` | `({ config?, children }) => JSX.Element` | Subtree-scoped defaults. |
| `useOgeCarouselConfig` | `() => OgeCarouselConfig` | Reads the resolved config. |
| `OGE_DEFAULT_CAROUSEL_CONFIG` | `OgeCarouselConfig` | The defaults. |
| `OGE_DEFAULT_CAROUSEL_MESSAGES` | `OgeCarouselMessages` | The English catalog. |
| `OgeCarouselConfig` | `{ messages: OgeCarouselMessages; indicators?; loop?; autoplayInterval?; showNavigation?; locale? }` | Resolved config shape. |
| `OgeCarouselConfigInput` | `Partial<OgeCarouselConfig> with partial messages` | What the provider accepts. |
| `OgeCarouselMessages` | `{ carousel; slide; label; previous; next; play; pause; picker; slideLabel; slideTitleLabel; goToSlide }` | The carousel catalog. |

## Demos

Each demo below is a complete standalone component — copy one whole and it compiles.

### Severities

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeAlert } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

export function AlertSeveritiesDemo() {
  return (
    <>
      <OgeAlert severity="info">A new version is available.</OgeAlert>
      <OgeAlert severity="success">Your changes were saved.</OgeAlert>
      <OgeAlert severity="warning">Your trial ends in three days.</OgeAlert>
      <OgeAlert severity="error">The payment could not be processed.</OgeAlert>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Styling modes

```ts
export function AlertModesDemo() {
```

### Title, actions & dismiss

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeAlert } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

export function AlertDismissDemo() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(true);
  return (
    <>
      <OgeAlert
        severity="warning"
        title="Storage almost full"
        dismissible
        visible={visible}
        onVisibleChange={setVisible}
        actions={<button type="button">Manage storage</button>}
      >
        You have used 92% of your quota.
      </OgeAlert>
      {!visible && (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setVisible(true)}>
          Show again
        </button>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

### Live regions

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeAlert } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

export function AlertLiveDemo() {
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setSaved(!saved)}>
        Toggle saved
      </button>
      <OgeAlert severity="success" visible={saved} onVisibleChange={setSaved}>
        Draft saved.
      </OgeAlert>
      <OgeAlert severity="info" live="off">
        This page is read-only.
      </OgeAlert>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Sticky & fixed (safe areas)

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeAppBar } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

const paragraphs = Array.from(
  { length: 8 },
  (_, i) => `Paragraph ${i + 1}: scroll inside this box — the bar stays on top.`,
);

export function AppBarStickyDemo() {
  return (
    <div
      role="region"
      aria-label="Scrolling article"
      tabIndex={0}
      style={{ maxHeight: 240, overflow: 'auto' }}
    >
      <OgeAppBar positionMode="sticky" elevated end={<button type="button">Share</button>}>
        <strong>Article</strong>
      </OgeAppBar>
      {paragraphs.map((paragraph) => (
        <p key={paragraph}>{paragraph}</p>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Bottom bar

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeAppBar } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

const messages = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => `Message ${i + 1}`);
const tabs = ['home', 'search', 'me'] as const;

export function AppBarBottomDemo() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<string>('home');
  return (
    <div
      role="region"
      aria-label="Phone screen"
      tabIndex={0}
      style={{ maxHeight: 240, overflow: 'auto' }}
    >
      {messages.map((message) => (
        <p key={message}>{message}</p>
      ))}
      <OgeAppBar position="bottom" positionMode="sticky" centerAlign="center">
        {tabs.map((option) => (
          <button
            key={option}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={tab === option}
            onClick={() => setTab(option)}
          >
            {option}
          </button>
        ))}
      </OgeAppBar>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Image, initials & icon

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeAvatar } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

export function AvatarContentDemo() {
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState('');
  return (
    <>
      {/* role="img" named by the name; the image, the initials and the icon are
          aria-hidden content of it. */}
      <OgeAvatar name="OGE UI" src="/logo.png" />
      <OgeAvatar
        name="Ada Lovelace"
        src="/missing-avatar.png"
        onImageFailed={(event) => setFailed(event.src)}
      />
      <OgeAvatar name="Grace Hopper" initials="GH" />
      <OgeAvatar ariaLabel="Guest" />
      <p>imageFailed → {failed || '—'}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Avatar group

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeAvatar, OgeAvatarGroup } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import type { OgeAvatarItem } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

const team: OgeAvatarItem[] = [
  { key: 1, name: 'Ada Lovelace', status: 'online' },
  { key: 2, name: 'Grace Hopper' },
  { key: 3, name: 'Alan Turing', status: 'away' },
  { key: 4, name: 'Edsger Dijkstra' },
  { key: 5, name: 'Barbara Liskov' },
  { key: 6, name: 'Donald Knuth' },
];
// three of 24 reviewers are loaded — total counts the rest into "+N"
const reviewers = team.slice(0, 3);

export function AvatarGroupDemo() {
  return (
    <>
      <OgeAvatarGroup items={team} max={4} ariaLabel="Project team" />
      <OgeAvatarGroup
        items={reviewers}
        max={4}
        total={24}
        size="sm"
        ariaLabel="Reviewers"
      />
      <OgeAvatarGroup overlap={false} ariaLabel="On call">
        <OgeAvatar name="Ada Lovelace" status="online" />
        <OgeAvatar name="Grace Hopper" status="busy" />
      </OgeAvatarGroup>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Chrome presets

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeCard } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

// outlined is the default; raised rests on the --oge-shadow-card token,
// filled sits on the header surface, flat is for a card nested inside
// another surface.
const modes = ['outlined', 'raised', 'filled', 'flat'] as const;

export function CardModesDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">

          <p className="text-sm">The {mode} chrome preset.</p>
        </OgeCard>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Actions alignment

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeCard } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import type { OgeCardActionsAlign } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

const aligns: readonly OgeCardActionsAlign[] = [
  'start',
  'center',
  'end',
  'stretched',
];

export function CardActionsDemo() {
  const [align, setAlign] = useState<OgeCardActionsAlign>('start');
  return (
    <div className="max-w-sm">
      <div className="mb-3 flex gap-2">
        {aligns.map((value) => (
          <button key={value} type="button" onClick={() => setAlign(value)}>
            {value}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <OgeCard
        header="Draft"
        actions={
          <div
            className={`oge-card-actions${align === 'start' ? '' : ` oge-card-actions-${align}`}`}
          >
            <button type="button">Discard</button>
            <button type="button">Save</button>
          </div>
        }
      >
        <p>Unsaved changes.</p>
      </OgeCard>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { OgeCard } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

export function CardStatesDemo() {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(true);
  return (
    <>
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <OgeCard
          header="Deploy failed"
          subheader="build #412"
          severity="danger"
          actions={
            <div className="oge-card-actions oge-card-actions-end">
              <button type="button">Retry</button>
            </div>
          }
        >
          <p className="text-sm">The e2e stage timed out after 20 minutes.</p>
        </OgeCard>
        <OgeCard header="Weekly report" subheader="loading…" loading={pending}>
          <p className="text-sm">Generated from last week&#39;s data.</p>
        </OgeCard>
      </div>
      <button type="button" className="mt-3" onClick={() => setPending(!pending)}>
        Toggle loading
      </button>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Clickable cards, accessibly

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeCard } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

// The stretched hit area, in your own stylesheet:
//
//   .oge-card { position: relative; }
//   .card-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; }
//
// Other controls stay usable by raising them above the overlay
// (position: relative + z-index).

export function CardClickableDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="max-w-sm">
      <OgeCard
        header="Mountains"
        subheader="Alps, 2026"
        interactive
        style={{ position: 'relative' }}
      >
        <p>Four days above the tree line.</p>
        <a className="card-link" href="/trips/alps-2026">
          Read the full report
        </a>
      </OgeCard>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Autoplay & rotation control

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeCarousel } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import type { OgeCarouselHandle, OgeCarouselItem } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

const destinations: OgeCarouselItem[] = [
  {
    key: 'coast',
    image: '/demo/carousel/coast.svg',
    imageAlt: 'A palm tree on a sandy beach by a calm blue sea',
    title: 'Turquoise Coast',
    description: 'Seven days of coves, ruins and slow mornings.',
  },
  {
    key: 'mountains',
    image: '/demo/carousel/mountains.svg',
    imageAlt: 'Snow-capped violet peaks under a pink evening sky',
    title: 'Kaçkar Mountains',
    description: 'Highland villages and the trail to the glacier lakes.',
  },
  {
    key: 'city',
    image: '/demo/carousel/city.svg',
    imageAlt: 'A city skyline with lit windows at sunset',
    title: 'Istanbul by night',
    description: 'Rooftops, ferries and the Bosphorus after dark.',
  },
];

export function CarouselAutoplayDemo() {
  const carousel = useRef<OgeCarouselHandle>(null);
  const [last, setLast] = useState('No events yet');
  return (
    <>
      <OgeCarousel
        ref={carousel}
        items={destinations}
        autoplay
        autoplayInterval={4000}
        height={300}
        ariaLabel="Rotating highlights"
        onSlideChanged={(e) => setLast(`slide ${e.index + 1} via ${e.source}`)}
        onAutoplayChanged={(e) =>
          setLast(`${e.playing ? 'playing' : 'stopped'} by ${e.source}`)
        }
      />
      <button type="button" onClick={() => carousel.current?.play()}>play()</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => carousel.current?.pause()}>pause()</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => carousel.current?.goTo(0)}>goTo(0)</button>
      <p>{last}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

```ts
const products: OgeCarouselItem[] = [

  { key: 'p2', title: 'Notebook', description: '€12 · dotted, A5' },
  { key: 'p3', title: 'Headphones', description: '€129 · noise cancelling' },
  { key: 'p4', title: 'Mug', description: '€15 · stoneware' },
  { key: 'p5', title: 'Backpack', description: '€89 · 20 litres' },
];

export function CarouselMultiDemo() {

    <OgeCarousel
      items={products}
      slidesPerView={3}
      gap={16}
      ariaLabel="Recommended products"
      renderSlide={({ item, active }) => (

          <strong>{item.title}</strong>
          <span>{item.description}</span>
```

### Selectable chips

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeChip } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

export function ChipSelectableDemo() {
  const [remote, setRemote] = useState(true);
  const [fullTime, setFullTime] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
```

### Removable chips

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeChip } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

export function ChipRemovableDemo() {
  const [tags, setTags] = useState(['Design', 'Research', 'Writing']);
  return (
    <>
      {tags.map((tag) => (
        <OgeChip
          key={tag}
          label={tag}
          removable
          onRemoved={() => setTags((current) => current.filter((t) => t !== tag))}
        />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

### Chip list — single selection

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeChipList } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import type { OgeChipItem, OgeChipKey } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

const SIZES: OgeChipItem[] = [
  { key: 's', label: 'Small' },
  { key: 'm', label: 'Medium' },
  { key: 'l', label: 'Large' },
  { key: 'xl', label: 'X-Large', disabled: true },
];

export function ChipSingleDemo() {
  const [size, setSize] = useState<readonly OgeChipKey[]>(['m']);
  return (
    <OgeChipList
      items={SIZES}
      selectionMode="single"
      selectedKeys={size}
      onSelectedKeysChange={setSize}
      ariaLabel="Size"
    />
  );
}
```

### Chip list — multiple selection (filters)

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeChipList } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import type { OgeChipItem, OgeChipKey } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

const FILTERS: OgeChipItem[] = [
  { key: 'open', label: 'Open' },
  { key: 'mine', label: 'Assigned to me' },
  { key: 'bug', label: 'Bug', severity: 'danger' },
  { key: 'docs', label: 'Docs', severity: 'accent' },
];

export function ChipMultipleDemo() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState<readonly OgeChipKey[]>(['open']);
  const [last, setLast] = useState('—');
  return (
    <>
      <OgeChipList
        items={FILTERS}
        selectionMode="multiple"
        selectedKeys={active}
        onSelectedKeysChange={setActive}
        ariaLabel="Filters"
        onSelectionChanged={(event) => setLast(event.item.label)}
      />
      <p>
        active: {active.join(', ') || 'none'} · last: {last}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Removable list (APG grid)

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeChipList } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import type { OgeChipItem } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

const PEOPLE: OgeChipItem[] = [
  { key: 1, label: 'Ada Lovelace', avatar: { name: 'Ada Lovelace' } },
  { key: 2, label: 'Grace Hopper', avatar: { name: 'Grace Hopper' } },
  { key: 3, label: 'Alan Turing', avatar: { name: 'Alan Turing' } },
  { key: 4, label: 'Katherine Johnson', avatar: { name: 'Katherine Johnson' } },
];

export function ChipGridDemo() {
  const [people, setPeople] = useState(PEOPLE);
  return (
    <OgeChipList
      items={people}
      removable
      ariaLabel="Recipients"
      onItemRemoved={(event) =>
        setPeople((current) => current.filter((p) => p.key !== event.item.key))
      }
    />
  );
}
```

### Custom chip template

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeChipList } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import type { OgeChipItem, OgeChipKey } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

const LANGUAGES: OgeChipItem[] = [
  { key: 'ts', label: 'TypeScript' },
  { key: 'rs', label: 'Rust' },
  { key: 'go', label: 'Go' },
];
const COUNTS: Record<string, number> = { ts: 128, rs: 42, go: 37 };

export function ChipTemplateDemo() {
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<readonly OgeChipKey[]>(['ts']);
  return (
    <OgeChipList
      items={LANGUAGES}
      selectionMode="multiple"
      selectedKeys={picked}
      onSelectedKeysChange={setPicked}
      ariaLabel="Languages"
      renderChip={({ item }) => (
        <>
          <strong>{item.label}</strong> <span className="opacity-70">{COUNTS[item.key]}</span>
        </>
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

### Basics & templates

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeDataView } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

interface Product {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  price: number;
  rating: number;
  inStock: boolean;
}

const products: Product[] = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Oak desk', category: 'Furniture', price: 420, rating: 4.6, inStock: true },
  { id: 2, name: 'Mesh office chair', category: 'Furniture', price: 260, rating: 4.4, inStock: true },
  { id: 3, name: 'Desk lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 45, rating: 4.1, inStock: false },
  { id: 4, name: 'Wall shelf', category: 'Storage', price: 89, rating: 3.9, inStock: true },
  { id: 5, name: 'Wool rug', category: 'Textiles', price: 150, rating: 4.8, inStock: true },
  { id: 6, name: 'Floor lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 120, rating: 4.2, inStock: true },
];

function Tile({ item }: { item: Product }) {
  return (
    <>
      <p className="category">{item.category}</p>
      <h3>{item.name}</h3>
      <p>
        {item.price} USD · ★ {item.rating}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

export function DataViewBasicsDemo() {
  return (
    <OgeDataView
      items={products}
      ariaLabel="Products"
      renderItem={({ item }) => <Tile item={item} />}
    />
  );
}
```

### Grid and list layouts

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeDataView } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import type { OgeDataViewLayout } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

interface Product {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  price: number;
  rating: number;
  inStock: boolean;
}

const products: Product[] = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Oak desk', category: 'Furniture', price: 420, rating: 4.6, inStock: true },
  { id: 2, name: 'Mesh office chair', category: 'Furniture', price: 260, rating: 4.4, inStock: true },
  { id: 3, name: 'Desk lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 45, rating: 4.1, inStock: false },
  { id: 4, name: 'Wall shelf', category: 'Storage', price: 89, rating: 3.9, inStock: true },
  { id: 5, name: 'Wool rug', category: 'Textiles', price: 150, rating: 4.8, inStock: true },
  { id: 6, name: 'Floor lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 120, rating: 4.2, inStock: true },
];

function Tile({ item }: { item: Product }) {
  return (
    <>
      <p className="category">{item.category}</p>
      <h3>{item.name}</h3>
      <p>
        {item.price} USD · ★ {item.rating}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

export function DataViewLayoutDemo() {
  const [layout, setLayout] = useState<OgeDataViewLayout>('grid');
  return (
    <>
      <OgeDataView
        items={products}
        layout={layout}
        onLayoutChange={setLayout}
        showLayoutSwitch
        minItemWidth={200}
        ariaLabel="Products by layout"
        renderItem={({ item }) => <Tile item={item} />}
        renderListItem={({ item }) => (
          <span>
            <strong>{item.name}</strong> — {item.category}, {item.price} USD
          </span>
        )}
      />
      <p>Layout: {layout}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Paging

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeDataView } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

interface Product {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  price: number;
  rating: number;
  inStock: boolean;
}

const products: Product[] = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Oak desk', category: 'Furniture', price: 420, rating: 4.6, inStock: true },
  { id: 2, name: 'Mesh office chair', category: 'Furniture', price: 260, rating: 4.4, inStock: true },
  { id: 3, name: 'Desk lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 45, rating: 4.1, inStock: false },
  { id: 4, name: 'Wall shelf', category: 'Storage', price: 89, rating: 3.9, inStock: true },
  { id: 5, name: 'Wool rug', category: 'Textiles', price: 150, rating: 4.8, inStock: true },
  { id: 6, name: 'Floor lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 120, rating: 4.2, inStock: true },
];

function Tile({ item }: { item: Product }) {
  return (
    <>
      <p className="category">{item.category}</p>
      <h3>{item.name}</h3>
      <p>
        {item.price} USD · ★ {item.rating}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

export function DataViewPagingDemo() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  return (
    <>
      <OgeDataView
        items={products}
        pageSize={2}
        pageIndex={page}
        onPageIndexChange={setPage}
        ariaLabel="Paged products"
        onPageChanged={(e) => console.log('page', e.previousPageIndex, '→', e.pageIndex)}
        renderItem={({ item }) => <Tile item={item} />}
      />
      <p>Page {page + 1}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Sorting, search & filtering

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeDataView } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import type { OgeDataViewSort } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

interface Product {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  price: number;
  rating: number;
  inStock: boolean;
}

const products: Product[] = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Oak desk', category: 'Furniture', price: 420, rating: 4.6, inStock: true },
  { id: 2, name: 'Mesh office chair', category: 'Furniture', price: 260, rating: 4.4, inStock: true },
  { id: 3, name: 'Desk lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 45, rating: 4.1, inStock: false },
  { id: 4, name: 'Wall shelf', category: 'Storage', price: 89, rating: 3.9, inStock: true },
  { id: 5, name: 'Wool rug', category: 'Textiles', price: 150, rating: 4.8, inStock: true },
  { id: 6, name: 'Floor lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 120, rating: 4.2, inStock: true },
];

function Tile({ item }: { item: Product }) {
  return (
    <>
      <p className="category">{item.category}</p>
      <h3>{item.name}</h3>
      <p>
        {item.price} USD · ★ {item.rating}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

const sortOptions = [
  { field: 'name', label: 'Name' },
  { field: 'price', label: 'Price' },
  { field: 'rating', label: 'Rating' },
];
const inStock = (product: Product) => product.inStock;

export function DataViewSortDemo() {
  const [inStockOnly, setInStockOnly] = useState(false);
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<OgeDataViewSort | null>({ field: 'price', direction: 'asc' });
  return (
    <>
      <label>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          checked={inStockOnly}
          onChange={(e) => setInStockOnly(e.target.checked)}
        />
        In stock only
      </label>
      <OgeDataView
        items={products}
        searchEnabled
        searchExpr={['name', 'category']}
        sortOptions={sortOptions}
        sort={sort}
        onSortChange={setSort}
        filter={inStockOnly ? inStock : null}
        ariaLabel="Searchable products"
        renderItem={({ item }) => <Tile item={item} />}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Selection

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeDataView } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import type { OgeDataViewKey } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

interface Product {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  price: number;
  rating: number;
  inStock: boolean;
}

const products: Product[] = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Oak desk', category: 'Furniture', price: 420, rating: 4.6, inStock: true },
  { id: 2, name: 'Mesh office chair', category: 'Furniture', price: 260, rating: 4.4, inStock: true },
  { id: 3, name: 'Desk lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 45, rating: 4.1, inStock: false },
  { id: 4, name: 'Wall shelf', category: 'Storage', price: 89, rating: 3.9, inStock: true },
  { id: 5, name: 'Wool rug', category: 'Textiles', price: 150, rating: 4.8, inStock: true },
  { id: 6, name: 'Floor lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 120, rating: 4.2, inStock: true },
];

function Tile({ item }: { item: Product }) {
  return (
    <>
      <p className="category">{item.category}</p>
      <h3>{item.name}</h3>
      <p>
        {item.price} USD · ★ {item.rating}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

export function DataViewSelectionDemo() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<OgeDataViewKey[]>([2]);
  return (
    <>
      <OgeDataView
        items={products}
        selectionMode="multiple"
        selectedKeys={selected}
        onSelectedKeysChange={setSelected}
        ariaLabel="Pick products"
        renderItem={({ item }) => <Tile item={item} />}
      />
      <p>Selected: {selected.join(', ') || 'none'}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Remote operations

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { OgeDataView } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import { ogeDataViewProcess } from '@oge-ui/behavior';
import type { OgeDataViewOptionsChangedEvent } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

interface Product {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  price: number;
  rating: number;
  inStock: boolean;
}

const products: Product[] = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Oak desk', category: 'Furniture', price: 420, rating: 4.6, inStock: true },
  { id: 2, name: 'Mesh office chair', category: 'Furniture', price: 260, rating: 4.4, inStock: true },
  { id: 3, name: 'Desk lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 45, rating: 4.1, inStock: false },
  { id: 4, name: 'Wall shelf', category: 'Storage', price: 89, rating: 3.9, inStock: true },
  { id: 5, name: 'Wool rug', category: 'Textiles', price: 150, rating: 4.8, inStock: true },
  { id: 6, name: 'Floor lamp', category: 'Lighting', price: 120, rating: 4.2, inStock: true },
];

function Tile({ item }: { item: Product }) {
  return (
    <>
      <p className="category">{item.category}</p>
      <h3>{item.name}</h3>
      <p>
        {item.price} USD · ★ {item.rating}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

export function DataViewRemoteDemo() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // stands in for an HTTP call: the "server" filters, sorts and slices
  const load = useCallback((options: OgeDataViewOptionsChangedEvent) => {
    setLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const all = ogeDataViewProcess(products, {
        searchValue: options.searchValue,
        searchExpr: ['name', 'category'],
        sort: options.sort,
      });
      const start = options.pageIndex * options.pageSize;
      setPage(all.slice(start, start + options.pageSize));
      setTotal(all.length);
      setLoading(false);
    }, 400);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load({ sort: null, searchValue: '', pageIndex: 0, pageSize: 3 });
  }, [load]);
  return (
    <OgeDataView
      items={page}
      itemCount={total}
      pageSize={3}
      remoteOperations
      loading={loading}
      searchEnabled
      sortOptions={[{ field: 'name', label: 'Name' }, { field: 'price', label: 'Price' }]}
      ariaLabel="Server products"
      onOptionsChanged={load}
      renderItem={({ item }) => <Tile item={item} />}
    />
  );
}
```

```ts
  { id: 2, name: 'Grace Hopper', role: 'Compiler lead', team: 'Platform' },
  { id: 3, name: 'Alan Turing', role: 'Cryptanalyst', team: 'Research', away: true },
  { id: 4, name: 'Margaret Hamilton', role: 'Flight software', team: 'Platform' },
  { id: 7, name: 'Barbara Liskov', role: 'Abstractions', team: 'Design' },
];

export function ListViewBasicsDemo() {

  return (
    <>
      {/* selectionMode "none" (the default) renders role="list" with a roving tab stop */}
      <OgeListView
        items={people}
        displayExpr="name"
        ariaLabel="Team"

            <small>{item.role}</small>
          </span>
        )}
      />
```

### Search & infinite scroll

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeListView } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

interface City {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

const NAMES = ['İstanbul', 'Ankara', 'Berlin', 'München', 'Paris', 'Zürich', 'Kraków', 'São Paulo'];

function page(index: number, size = 16): City[] {
  return Array.from({ length: size }, (_, i) => {
    const n = index * size + i;
    return { id: n + 1, name: `${NAMES[n % NAMES.length]} ${n + 1}` };
  });
}

export function ListViewSearchDemo() {
  const [cities, setCities] = useState<City[]>(() => page(0));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const loadMore = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setCities((current) => [...current, ...page(current.length / 16)]);
      setLoading(false);
    }, 600);
  };
  return (
    <OgeListView
      items={cities}
      displayExpr="name"
      searchEnabled
      pageLoadMode="scroll"
      hasMore={cities.length < 96}
      loading={loading}
      height={300}
      ariaLabel="Cities"
      onLoadMoreRequested={loadMore}
    />
  );
}
```

### Swipe actions

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeListView } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';
import type { OgeListViewItemAction } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

interface Message {
  id: number;
  from: string;
  subject: string;
}

const actions: OgeListViewItemAction[] = [
  { key: 'archive', label: 'Archive', severity: 'accent', shortcut: 'Shift+A' },
  { key: 'delete', label: 'Delete', severity: 'danger', shortcut: 'Delete' },
];

export function ListViewActionsDemo() {
  const [inbox, setInbox] = useState<Message[]>([
    { id: 1, from: 'Build bot', subject: 'Nightly build passed' },
    { id: 2, from: 'Ayşe Kaya', subject: 'Design review moved to Friday' },
    { id: 3, from: 'Billing', subject: 'Your invoice for October' },
  ]);
  const [last, setLast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <OgeListView
        items={inbox}
        displayExpr="subject"
        selectionMode="single"
        itemActions={actions}
        ariaLabel="Inbox"
        onItemActionClick={(event) => {
          setLast(`${event.action.label}: ${event.item.subject}`);
          setInbox((current) => current.filter((m) => m.id !== event.key));
        }}
      />
      <p>Last action: {last ?? '—'}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Covering a container

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeLoadPanel } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

export function LoadPanelContainerDemo() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const reload = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => setLoading(false), 2000);
  };
  return (
    <section className="orders">
      {/* covers its own parent; aria-busy + one announcement while shown */}
      <OgeLoadPanel visible={loading} />
      <h3>Orders</h3>

        Reload
      </button>
    </section>
  );
```

### Delay & minimum time

```ts
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { OgeLoadPanel } from '@oge-ui/react-layout';

export function LoadPanelTimingDemo() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [events, setEvents] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const load = (ms: number) => {
    setEvents([]);
    setLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => setLoading(false), ms);
  };
  return (
    <section>
      <OgeLoadPanel
        visible={loading}
        showDelay={300}
        minDisplayTime={800}
        onShown={() => setEvents((e) => [...e, 'shown'])}
        onHidden={() => setEvents((e) => [...e, 'hidden'])}
      />
      <button type="button" onClick={() => load(100)}>
        Fast load (100 ms)
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => load(1500)}>
        Slow load (1.5 s)
      </button>
      <p>Events: {events.join(' ') || 'none'}</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```ts
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setChartLoading(!chartLoading)}>
        Render chart
```
